overview: The School Committee met to vote on entering an executive session to address a labor grievance, litigation strategy, and contract negotiations for non-union administrative personnel.

items.title: Call to Order and Roll Call
items.summary: The meeting was called to order, the roll was called, and the committee performed the Pledge of Allegiance.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved a motion to enter executive session and not reconvene in public to discuss a Massachusetts Teachers Association grievance, strategy for potential litigation, and contract negotiations for non-union administrative staff including principals and directors.
